# Encyclopedia.com

> A comprehensive free online encyclopedia offering millions of articles across science, history, culture, medicine, and more for research and educational purposes.

Encyclopedia.com provides a broad collection of reference materials organized into major subject categories including history, science, medicine, arts, philosophy, and social sciences. The site serves as a multi-topic knowledge base for students, researchers, and general learners seeking reliable encyclopedic information.

## Key Topics

- Encyclopedia reference
- Free online knowledge base
- History and civilizations
- Science and technology
- Medicine and health

## Core Reference Categories

- [History Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/history): Reference index for world history, ancient civilizations, and empires
- [Science and Technology Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/science-and-technology): Reference index for astronomy, physics, chemistry, and biology
- [Medicine Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/medicine): Medical reference covering history and disciplines of medicine
- [Philosophy and Religion Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/philosophy-and-religion): Reference guide to world religions and philosophical belief systems
- [Literature and the Arts Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/literature-and-arts): Reference guide to literature, arts, and performing arts topics

## Geography and Natural Sciences

- [Places Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/places): Geographic reference directory for world regions and locations
- [Earth and the Environment Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/earth-and-environment): Reference guide to Earth sciences, geology, and environmental topics
- [Plants and Animals Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/plants-and-animals): Reference guide to botany, zoology, and agricultural topics

## Social Sciences and Practical Knowledge

- [Social Sciences and the Law Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/social-sciences-and-law): Reference guide to law, economics, sociology, and social sciences
- [Sports and Everyday Life Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/sports-and-everyday-life): Reference guide to sports, fashion, food, games, and hobbies
- [Articles and How-To Guides](https://www.encyclopedia.com/articles): How-to guides and reference articles on business, finance, and taxes

## People and Biographies

- [People Category](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people): Biographical reference directory of notable historical figures

## Featured Articles

- [Boston Tea Party](https://www.encyclopedia.com/history/united-states-and-canada/us-history/boston-tea-party): Historical encyclopedia entry on the Boston Tea Party of 1773
- [Autism](https://www.encyclopedia.com/medicine/diseases-and-conditions/pathology/autism): Medical encyclopedia entry on autism diagnosis and symptoms
- [Pure Land Buddhism](https://www.encyclopedia.com/philosophy-and-religion/eastern-religions/buddhism/pure-land-buddhism): Encyclopedia entry on Pure Land Buddhism traditions and practices
- [Income Tax](https://www.encyclopedia.com/social-sciences-and-law/economics-business-and-labor/taxation/income-tax): Encyclopedia entry on income tax history and legislation
